title: Bind mount a directory to another directory
summary: Make the contents of one directory accessible in another location without copying files.

steps.explain: Use the --bind flag to make the old directory appear in the new directory.

placeholders.name: OLD_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The source directory containing the files

placeholders.name: NEW_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The target directory where the files will appear

warnings: Changes made in the new directory will affect the files in the old directory.
